svg.title: NyanBoss POIs on Customs
svg.desc: Top-down plot in game coordinates of the two scav base patrol circles, Scav Base East at 260, -80 and Scav Base Centre at 200, -135, each 60 metres in radius, with spawn points from the game data.
svg.text: Spawn data from SPT 4.1.6 (bigmap). Positions are game coordinates, so this may not match the orientation of a printed map.

circle.title: Scav Base East: centre 260, -80, radius 50 m
Scav Base Centre: centre 200, -135, radius 50 m
